quiz.question_id: Kapan `context.Background()` paling tepat digunakan menurut lesson?
quiz.question_en: When is `context.Background()` most appropriate according to the lesson?
options_id: Sebagai root context di `main`, startup server, atau test
Sebagai pengganti context request yang sudah diberikan handler
Di dalam struct agar mudah disimpan
options_en: As the root context in `main`, server startup, or tests
As a replacement for the request context already provided by a handler
Only when you want a 5-second timeout
Inside a struct so it is easy to store

quiz.question_id: Apa perbedaan utama `context.TODO()` dibanding `context.Background()` pada penjelasan lesson?
quiz.question_en: What is the main difference between `context.TODO()` and `context.Background()` in the lesson?
options_id: `TODO()` adalah placeholder ketika Anda belum tahu context yang tepat
`Background()` selalu panic bila dipass ke goroutine
Keduanya harus selalu disimpan di struct
options_en: `TODO()` is a placeholder when you do not yet know the right context
`TODO()` automatically has a deadline
`Background()` always panics if passed to a goroutine
Both must always be stored in a struct

quiz.question_id: Mengapa `defer cancel()` tetap dipanggil walau operasi mungkin selesai sebelum timeout?
quiz.question_en: Why is `defer cancel()` still called even if the operation may finish before the timeout?
options_id: Untuk membebaskan resource terkait context lebih awal sesuai anjuran lesson
Agar context dapat dipakai ulang untuk request berikutnya
Karena tanpa itu `http.Client` tidak bisa membaca body
options_en: To release context-related resources early as recommended by the lesson
So the context can be reused for the next request
So `ctx.Done()` sends a boolean `true`
Because otherwise `http.Client` cannot read the body

quiz.question_id: Perbedaan inti `WithTimeout` dan `WithDeadline` pada lesson adalah...
quiz.question_en: The core difference between `WithTimeout` and `WithDeadline` in the lesson is...
options_id: `WithTimeout` menerima durasi relatif, `WithDeadline` menerima waktu absolut
`WithTimeout` hanya untuk HTTP, `WithDeadline` hanya untuk database
options_en: `WithTimeout` takes a relative duration, `WithDeadline` takes an absolute time
`WithTimeout` is only for HTTP and `WithDeadline` only for databases
`WithDeadline` does not need `cancel()`
`WithTimeout` cannot trigger cancellation

quiz.question_id: Mengapa `http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, ...)` lebih tepat daripada membuat request tanpa context pada contoh timeout?
quiz.question_en: Why is `http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, ...)` more appropriate than creating a request without context in the timeout example?
options_id: Agar deadline dan cancellation dari context ikut memengaruhi request HTTP
Agar body response otomatis menjadi JSON
options_en: So the context's deadline and cancellation also affect the HTTP request
So the request automatically becomes POST
So `client.Do` no longer needs error handling
So the response body automatically becomes JSON

quiz.question_id: Pada pola `select` di `longTask`, apa arti case `<-ctx.Done()`?
quiz.question_en: In the `select` pattern in `longTask`, what does the case `<-ctx.Done()` mean?
options_id: Cek channel yang akan ditutup saat context dibatalkan atau deadline tercapai
Baca sisa waktu timeout dalam milidetik
options_en: Check the channel that will be closed when the context is canceled or its deadline is reached
Read the remaining timeout in milliseconds
Pull a request-scoped value from the context
Start a new goroutine for cleanup

quiz.question_id: Apa yang dikembalikan `ctx.Err()` setelah cancellation terdeteksi?
quiz.question_en: What does `ctx.Err()` return after cancellation is detected?
options_en: `context.Canceled` or `context.DeadlineExceeded` depending on the cause
Always `nil`
The request path as a string
The original timeout duration

quiz.question_id: Rule mana yang secara eksplisit disebut lesson tentang penempatan argument context?
quiz.question_en: Which rule does the lesson explicitly state about where the context argument should go?
options_id: Selalu jadi argumen pertama dan dinamai `ctx`
options_en: It should always be the first argument and be named `ctx`
It should always be the last argument
It is only used on receiver methods
It must be stored in a struct field

quiz.question_id: Larangan mana yang juga ditegaskan lesson dalam penggunaan context?
quiz.question_en: Which prohibition about context usage does the lesson also emphasize?
options_id: Jangan pernah pass context ke goroutine lain
Jangan gunakan context pada HTTP sama sekali
options_en: Do not store a context in a struct
Never pass a context to another goroutine
Do not use context with HTTP at all
Do not call `cancel()`

quiz.question_id: Jika `fetchURL` gagal karena timeout context, pemeriksaan mana yang ditunjukkan lesson di caller?
quiz.question_en: If `fetchURL` fails because of a context timeout, which check does the lesson show in the caller?
options_en: `if ctx.Err() == context.DeadlineExceeded`
`if err == io.EOF`
`if resp.StatusCode == 408`
`if cancel == nil`
